reason: Reproduced independently on Go 1.26.6 with my own woven customer-shaped packages: legal integral untyped float bounds (string and byte forms, low/high/full) and an integral untyped complex bound all pass plain go test but fail the woven build with '<generated>:1: float64/complex128 does not satisfy ... integer'. The pinned join-point guard (slice_expression.go:69-77) checks the resolved types.Basic kind, but go/types has already contextualized these bounds to int, so the UntypedFloat/UntypedComplex exclusion never fires; the dd-iast-go template re-emits the raw constant into a generic helper constrained to 'integer', which infers float64/complex128. The same inference failure reproduces with a plain (non-woven) direct helper call on both go1.26.6 and go1.27.0. Finder's own reproducer re-ran with the identical error. Not documented in README or design intent; violates product rule 1 (compile failure on valid customer code) with no configuration escape hatch; compile failure is Critical by the brief's scale regardless of how rare the constant syntax is.
